posts.cooked:
The rules are hard and fast, but also fast and loose. They’re hard and loose rules. Like an armored bracer you wear around your wrist, but it’s sized to fit on your thigh, so you put it on your arm and it just falls off. But it’s very hard, would protect you well, if it wasn’t all loosey-goosey. The Bracer of Gussiye, magic item confirmed.

Good thing we’re past all five of the world wars…

I like the idea that Orbo has a phone the size of Mount Everest and a computer the size of Australia, both of which Jansa takes away after eats three of Jupiter’s moons…

I will hunt all of the humans to extinction to devour their succulent Christopher meat.

Il Alimento with Chef Phrentat. Because he definitely eats.

I wonder if that person (Chaos Clockwork, I think) who was going to make a board game actually did.

They were prolific to the point of being profligate. God, what a number six months of radio silence has to have done on their heads.
